import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from bct.v4.free_ai import (GROQ_SCHEMA, HTTPAdapter, Router, SYSTEM, QUOTE_SCHEMA,
                          VERSION, checked_config, source_input, validate_reading)
from bct.v4.store import Ledger, encode, sha

OUT = Path('var/v4/groq-stage2/restored-live-check')
BASE = '599c4b7df9c2290f0c626b74f93e42c39f83e9f3'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == BASE
assert not (OUT / 'live-result.json').exists(), 'CURRENT_TASK_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED'
config = checked_config(json.loads(Path('var/v4/groq-stage2/trial-config.json').read_text()))
assert config['providers'] == ['groq'] and config['max_calls_per_run'] == 1
assert config['accounts']['groq']['verified_free'] is True
assert config['accounts']['groq']['tier'] == 'Free'

namespace = {'__name__': 'bct.v4.accepted_baseline', '__package__': 'bct.v4'}
baseline = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'fd199ea1feafbb32cce553e63c51351211a78289:src/bct/v4/free_ai.py'], text=True)
exec(compile(baseline, '<accepted-schema-baseline>', 'exec'), namespace)
assert GROQ_SCHEMA == namespace['GROQ_SCHEMA'], 'SCHEMA_DIFFERS_FROM_ACCEPTED_BASELINE'

def check_schema(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        if node.get('type') == 'object':
            assert node['additionalProperties'] is False
            assert set(node['required']) == set(node['properties'])
        assert 'maxItems' not in node
        for value in node.values():
            check_schema(value)
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for value in node:
            check_schema(value)
check_schema(GROQ_SCHEMA)
assert 'Use zero for all start/end' in SYSTEM

ledger = Ledger('var/v4/groq-stage2/live')
try:
    router = Router(ledger, config)
    assert router.available('groq') is None, 'FREE_ACCOUNT_NOT_AVAILABLE'
    doc = router.reviewed_document(ledger.latest_documents()[0])
    old = json.loads(Path('var/v4/groq-stage2/quote-repair/artifacts-verified.json').read_text())
    assert doc['document_id'] == old['document_id']
    body_sha = hashlib.sha256(doc['body'].encode()).hexdigest()
    raw = ledger.db.execute('SELECT data FROM blobs WHERE id=?', (doc['raw_sha256'],)).fetchone()[0]
    assert body_sha == old['body_sha256'] == doc['body_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == old['raw_sha256'] == doc['raw_sha256']
    received = router.events('API_RECEIVED')
    old_response = next(x for x in received if hashlib.sha256(x['text'].encode()).hexdigest() == old['response_sha256'])
    source = source_input(doc, config, router.env)
    previous_validation = validate_reading(old_response['text'], doc, source)
    assert len(previous_validation['items']) == 1 and len(previous_validation['rejected_items']) == 4
    url, _, payload = HTTPAdapter({}).request('groq', source, config['max_output_tokens'])
    assert url == 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions'
    assert payload['response_format']['json_schema']['schema'] == GROQ_SCHEMA
    assert payload['model'] == 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' and payload['max_completion_tokens'] == 2048
    assert payload['reasoning_effort'] == 'low' and 'tools' not in payload
    reserve = len(encode(payload).encode()) + config['max_output_tokens']
    assert reserve == 6124 and router.budget('groq', reserve) is None
    assert not any(x['request_contract'] == router.request_contract for x in router.events('API_CONFIG_ERROR'))
    key = sha([VERSION, SYSTEM, QUOTE_SCHEMA, source, doc['body_sha256']])
    assert not any(x['input_key'] == key for x in router.events('API_ATTEMPT'))
    reused = json.loads(Path('docs/v4/GROQ_QUOTE_REPAIR_RESULTS.json').read_text())['evidence_reuse']
    for entry in reused['unchanged_files']:
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(entry['file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
    tracked = ['src/bct/v4/free_ai.py', 'src/bct/v4/store.py', 'tests/test_v4_free_ai.py', 'tests/test_v4_quote_binding.py']
    code_hashes = {}
    for name in tracked:
        prior = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{BASE}:{name}'])
        assert prior == Path(name).read_bytes()
        code_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(prior).hexdigest()
    evidence_files = sorted(Path('docs/v4').glob('QUOTE_REPAIR_*TESTS.xml'))
    report = {
        'at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'PASS_LOCAL_PREFLIGHT', 'base_sha': BASE,
        'wire_schema_matches_accepted_baseline': True, 'wire_schema_sha256': sha(GROQ_SCHEMA),
        'payload_sha256': sha(payload), 'request_contract': router.request_contract, 'input_key': key,
        'original_artifacts': old, 'source': source, 'provenance': doc['provenance'],
        'body_status': doc['body_status'], 'reservation_tokens': reserve, 'budget_cap': 6400,
        'generation_cap': 1, 'api_calls': 0, 'baseline_attempts': len(router.events('API_ATTEMPT')),
        'baseline_received': len(received), 'baseline_seq': ledger.db.execute('SELECT MAX(seq) FROM events').fetchone()[0],
        'saved_response_revalidation': {'accepted': 1, 'rejected': 4, 'source_status': previous_validation['source_status']},
        'unchanged_runtime_code_sha256': code_hashes,
        'reused_test_evidence_sha256': {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in evidence_files},
        'test_reuse': '38 new + 25 affected prior PASS reused unchanged; historical 99/261 not rerun',
        'core_reuse_unchanged_files': len(reused['unchanged_files']),
        'free_plan': 'Previously user-confirmed Free; current evidence and guards reused',
        'gemini': 'DISABLED_NOT_CALLED', 'reacquisition_requests': 0,
    }
    (OUT / 'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ('status', 'baseline_attempts', 'baseline_received', 'reservation_tokens', 'generation_cap', 'saved_response_revalidation')}, ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
    ledger.close()
verification_scripts.verify_saved.py:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from bct.v4.free_ai import Router, source_input, validate_reading
from bct.v4.store import Ledger

OUT = Path('var/v4/groq-stage2/restored-live-check')
pre = json.loads((OUT / 'preflight.json').read_text())
config = json.loads(Path('var/v4/groq-stage2/trial-config.json').read_text())
root = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'var/v4/groq-stage2/live'

class NoNetwork:
    def call(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('UNEXPECTED_DUPLICATE_NETWORK_CALL')

ledger = Ledger(root)
try:
    with ledger.worker():
        router = Router(ledger, config, adapter=NoNetwork())
        attempts = router.events('API_ATTEMPT')
        assert len(attempts) == pre['baseline_attempts'] + 1
        last = attempts[-1]
        assert last['input_key'] == pre['input_key']
        received = [x for x in router.events('API_RECEIVED') if x['attempt_id'] == last['attempt_id']]
        responses = [x for x in router.events('API_RESPONSE') if x['attempt_id'] == last['attempt_id']]
        validations = [x for x in router.events('API_VALIDATION') if x['attempt_id'] == last['attempt_id']]
        assert len(received) == len(responses) == len(validations) == 1
        raw = received[0]
        assert raw['text'] == responses[0]['text']
        assert raw['usage'] == {'input_tokens': 904, 'output_tokens': 701, 'total_tokens': 1605}
        doc = router.reviewed_document(ledger.latest_documents()[0])
        original = pre['original_artifacts']
        assert doc['body_sha256'] == original['body_sha256']
        assert hashlib.sha256(doc['body'].encode()).hexdigest() == original['body_sha256']
        blob = ledger.db.execute('SELECT data FROM blobs WHERE id=?', (doc['raw_sha256'],)).fetchone()[0]
        assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest() == original['raw_sha256']
        assert any(hashlib.sha256(x['text'].encode()).hexdigest() == original['response_sha256'] for x in router.events('API_RECEIVED'))
        selected = source_input(doc, config, router.env)
        assert selected == pre['source']
        result = validate_reading(raw['text'], doc, selected)
        assert result == validations[0]['result']
        assert result['source_status'] == 'PASS' and not result['rejected_items'] and len(result['items']) == 3
        raw_items = json.loads(raw['text'])['items']
        quote_checks = []
        corrected_ranges = 0
        for item in result['items']:
            assert item['s_stage'] == 'UNKNOWN' and item['forecast_candidate'] is False
            assert item['semantic_status'] == 'UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW'
            assert item['role'] == 'UNKNOWN'
            source_item = raw_items[item['input_item_index']]
            citations = [('context', item['context'], source_item['context']),
                         ('entity', item['entity'], source_item['entity'])]
            citations += [(fact['field'], fact, old) for fact, old in zip(item['facts'], source_item['facts'])]
            for field, citation, ai_citation in citations:
                if field != 'context' and citation['value'] is None:
                    assert citation['quote'] == '' and citation['reference'] is None
                    continue
                a, b, text = citation['start'], citation['end'], citation['quote']
                assert doc['body'][a:b] == text
                assert doc['body'].find(text) == a and doc['body'].find(text, a + 1) == -1
                assert any(w['start'] <= a < b <= w['end'] for w in selected['windows'])
                if field != 'context':
                    assert citation['value'] in text
                ref = citation['reference']
                assert ref['source_quote'] == text and ref['locator'] == {'start': a, 'end': b}
                assert ref['published_at'] == doc['published_at']
                assert ref['body_sha256'] == doc['body_sha256']
                corrected = (ai_citation['start'], ai_citation['end']) != (a, b)
                corrected_ranges += int(corrected)
                quote_checks.append({'item_index': item['input_item_index'], 'field': field,
                                     'quote': text, 'start': a, 'end': b,
                                     'exact_unique_within_input': True,
                                     'ai_positions_discarded': corrected})
        assert len(quote_checks) == 7 and corrected_ranges == 7
        project, partnership, product = result['items']
        assert project['entity']['value'] == 'Advanced Nuclear Fuel Line Pilot Projects'
        assert project['kind'] == 'PROJECT' and project['target']['product'] is None
        assert partnership['entity']['value'] is None and partnership['kind'] == 'GENERAL_EXPRESSION'
        assert product['entity']['value'] == 'advanced light-water SMRs' and product['kind'] == 'PRODUCT_FAMILY'
        cached = router.read(doc, probe_provider='groq')
        assert cached['status'] == 'PASS' and cached['cached'] is True and cached['result'] == result
        assert router.calls == 0 and len(router.events('API_ATTEMPT')) == len(attempts)
        assert doc['body_status'] == 'PARTIAL' and doc['provenance'] == 'BLOCKED'
        assert ledger.db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0] == 'ok'
        observation = {
            'root': root, 'at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'PASS_SQLITE_REOPEN_CACHE',
            'source_items': len(result['items']), 'rejected_items': 0, 'exact_quotes': len(quote_checks),
            'quote_checks': quote_checks, 'model_ranges_ignored_and_recomputed': corrected_ranges,
            'duplicate_network_calls': router.calls, 'cumulative_attempts': len(attempts),
            'usage': raw['usage'], 'response_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw['text'].encode()).hexdigest(),
            'raw_response': json.loads(raw['text']), 'raw_response_text': raw['text'],
            'quota_headers': raw.get('quota_headers'), 'stored_validated_result': result,
            'source': {'url': doc['origin_url'], 'document_id': doc['document_id'],
                       'body_sha256': doc['body_sha256'], 'raw_sha256': doc['raw_sha256'],
                       'published_at': doc['published_at'], 'scope': selected['provenance_scope'],
                       'body_status': doc['body_status'], 'provenance': doc['provenance']},
            'limited_semantic_checks': {'project_kind': 'PASS', 'SMR_family_kind': 'PASS_AFTER_EXISTING_RULE',
                                        'funding_and_partnership_not_supply': 'PASS_ROLE_UNKNOWN'},
            'semantic_accuracy': 'UNKNOWN',
            'semantic_review_issues': [
                {'item_index': 2, 'field': 'quantity', 'value': '$800 million',
                 'reason': 'Funding amount, not product units or production capacity.'},
                {'item_index': 2, 'field': 'customer_group', 'value': 'TVA and Holtec',
                 'reason': 'Named funding recipients; source does not establish actual product customers.'},
                {'item_index': 1, 'field': 'entity', 'value': None,
                 'reason': 'Westinghouse technology name not extracted; UNKNOWN preserved, completeness not established.'},
            ],
            's_stage_promotions': 0, 'stage3_started': False, 'shadow_started': False,
        }
        name = 'live-reopen.json' if root.endswith('/live') else 'backup-reopen.json'
        (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(observation, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        if root.endswith('/live'):
            ledger.backup(OUT / 'final-backup/v4.sqlite3')
        print(json.dumps({k: observation[k] for k in ('root', 'status', 'source_items', 'exact_quotes', 'model_ranges_ignored_and_recomputed', 'duplicate_network_calls', 'cumulative_attempts', 'semantic_accuracy')}, ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
    ledger.close()
